sections.heading: Meeting time and date
paragraphs: Meetings will resume in 2023 on an every-other-month schedule. Schedule of 2023 meetings will be posted on this page soon.

sections.heading: Meeting venue
paragraphs: TICD community construction meetings are currently held virtually on Zoom.

sections.heading: TICD Construction Hotline
paragraphs: Call the TICD Construction Hotline at any time with any questions or concerns related to construction activities associated with the TI/YBI redevelopment project.
